verdict.rationale: Kitty's first-party docs have sections on changing colors, using your own themes, changing the theme non-interactively, and switching color themes automatically when the OS changes between light and dark. Together these cover both theme application and automatic light/dark switching. missing for 10: evidence beyond section titles (no detail on how the theme kitten or the auto-switch config works), independent or hands-on corroboration of auto light/dark switching.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can apply color schemes and themes, including automatic light/dark mode switching

citations.quote: Change color themes automatically when the OS switches between light and dark
